original.statement: The `CancelHealthCheckOnNewRevision` feature gate is introduced in kustomize-controller.

decision.reason: [ev-3ade4dee13c7] lists "`CancelHealthCheckOnNewRevision` feature gate (kustomize-controller)" under "Overview of the new features" in the v2.7.0 release. That supports a feature-gate subject with the exact name and the kustomize-controller component, and a change of type added. The validators returned inconclusive because the chart was unavailable, so they neither confirm nor refute this.
